The first Black Friday deals are already live, and plenty more brands will announce theirs over the next ten days. I gave up on keeping this list concise because there are simply way too many places with seriously good deals. With that said, my focus is on the most tempting offers of 20% off and more. Very rarely do I zoom in on 15% discounts, but SkinMedica is never on sale, so it deserves a shoutout.

Share this post, save it for the weekend, spread the word. Stock up as needed and shop responsibly. Enjoy the holiday break and be kind to yourself. And your skin.

Side note: some of these deals start later in the week, so check the dates on each one. I update this post daily as new offers go live, so save it and come back often.
